window_policy: Exactly the latest 30 complete UTC days; no window search. Only October 20 is beyond the previous MR40 input cutoff. Report its incremental contribution separately.
sizing: Unchanged all-cash Spot long/flat; independent new research accounts. The frozen 10000-unit engine is normalized linearly to 500 and checked against independent Decimal accounting initialized with 500.
episode_policy: Reuse unchanged pinned admission module; previous closed bar, next open; a rejected episode cannot enter late. Natural z>=0 exit unchanged. Tagged terminal liquidation only if still invested at the fixed endpoint.
source: Only the complete BTCUSDT Spot October 20 daily trade file on public.bybit.com; reuse verified prefix. No substitute exchange, imputation, current candle or repeated old raw ingestion.
